name: Gulf Oil Lubricants India Ltd
title: Gulf Oil Lubricants India Ltd - 538567 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Volume-led Q1 FY27: core lube volume +17% YoY to 48,000 KL and revenue +33% to INR 1,320 cr, but margin held ~13% only via pass-through; full cost pass-through lands in Q2/Q3 while base oil stays tight.

utilisation.quote: our capacity is in full stream, no problem

capex.quote: Chennai is on track. Silvassa, we are also expecting that some of the augmented production will start and that also should be there by financial year end.

triggers.label: Multiple B2C price hikes in quarter
triggers.quote: we have seen close to 3 increases, which has happened starting March end, April beginning, which is practically every month or so

triggers.label: Capacity expansion ~70% by FY-end
triggers.quote: Silvassa and Chennai, as we announced 70% increase in capacity

triggers.label: Margin per litre protected, % diluted
triggers.quote: The percentage margins are slightly dilutive in these kinds of inflationary environment

triggers.label: Inventory build INR 108-109 cr
triggers.quote: our inventory has gone up by INR108 crores this quarter at the end of the quarter

guidance.value: 2x to 3x industry growth, double-digit value growth
guidance.quote: we will continue to grow 2 to 3x the market with the EBITDA band, which we will try to maintain in the range of 12% to 14%
on a long -term sustainable basis, yes, our 12% to 14% guided band is still intact
take the EV business as per our earlier guidance in the range of around INR300 crores to INR400 crores in 3 to 4 years

guidance.value: 70% capacity increase, phased; Chennai by Dec, Silvassa by FY-end
guidance.quote: Chennai is on track. Silvassa, we are also expecting that some of the augmented production will start

prior_guidance_check.quote: We've been able to keep the margin at 13%, which is within the guided range

red_flags.label: Margin % diluted by pass-through; base oil still rising
red_flags.quote: the base oil pricing so far is not reflecting such decrease anywhere close to that

evasions.quote: As a percentage, we are obviously not getting into details
we normally would not like to give that detail because it's a large part of us is related to contracts
we don't calculate gross margins on a daily basis

summary.headline: Gulf Oil Q1 FY27 revenue rose 33% to INR 1,320 crore and EBITDA 35% to INR 170 crore, with lubes volume up 17% to 48,000 KL.
